scope: Literal English for the15 remaining bounded item definitions, including equipment state and reserved/unclear records. These are not declared unused or normal acquireable items. Native formatting/description tests are required; mechanics and definitions are unchanged.

entries.name: Bare hands
entries.description:
Nothing is equipped. Some skills can
be used with bare hands.
